notes.title: Bugfix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where the game did not save under certain conditions.

notes.title: Update March 19th
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, hope you are all doing well!

We added a lot of things in this new update. Here is the list:
[olist]
[*] Added mouse support on menus
[*] Default controls changed to WASD (you can still customize them as you wish)
[*] Custom keys
[*] Full controller support
[*] Optimized music and sound effects (Meaning: Higher fps)
[*] Faster loading times
[*] Added the option to go to previous checkpoints (Great to find missed souls)
[*] 6 New languages (Italian, French, German, Korean, Japanese, Tradicional Chinese)
[*] You can now skip cutscenes
[/olist]

Thank you all and have a great weekend!

Follow us on social media!
Discord: http://discord.gg/uSTkerV
Twitter: @DoublehitGames, @kwalee

notes.title: January 29th update
Patch notes 7.6
notes.notes:
Hi everybody,

We spent the last few days improving a few things in the game and fixing some bugs. Here are the patch notes of this update:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the player from unlocking achievements even when the requirements were met.
[*] Added a new visual feedback when you're in the Temple Boss' sight.
[*] Improved player's swing movement on certain ropes.
[*] Fixed a few audio issues.
[*] Increased the range to grab the magical sphere.
[*] Tips are now displayed in the selected language.
[*] Fixed other minor bugs.
[/list]

In the next update we will add Russian and Chinese localization.

Thank you for playing Eternal Hope!

notes.title: Release date on August 20th
notes.notes:
[b]Development Update[/b]

Hey guys, hope you're all doing well!

We have decided to move the release date of Eternal Hope from August 13 to August 20.

We'd like to apologize for announcing it this close to the original release date. Even though we've been working really hard these past few weeks, we feel that we still need a few more days to work on the game. This extra week will allow us to fix some bugs and add an extra polishment.

We really hope you understand! Thank you all! <3

notes.title: Eternal Hope: Prologue Release!
notes.notes:
Hey guys, hope you're having a great day!

I come bearing news... Great news :)

Today we released the first act of Eternal Hope for free. It has its own page on Steam and it's called [b]Eternal Hope: Prologue[/b]! Hopefully it will help us spread the word and also give you a taste of what's to come!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1325880/Eternal_Hope_Prologue/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1325880/Eternal_Hope_Prologue/[/url]

We've been working very hard on this project for the past 3 years and we are very proud of what we managed to create with such a small team (4 people working full-time and 2 composers creating our music).

I hope you have a great experience and get immersed in the story. You will see this fantasy world we created through Ti'bi's eyes. It will be a journey full of ups and downs but in the end it will all be worth it!

Thank you again and have fun!

- Angelo
